# pbs_acme_tos (Data Source)

Reads the URL of the terms of service an ACME directory advertises, which `tos_url` of `pbs_acme_account` agrees to. PBS fetches the directory itself, so it must reach the CA. Any user may read it.

Let's Encrypt publishes a new URL with each version of its subscriber agreement; an account registered already records a new one in state without contacting the CA.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The terms of service of Let's Encrypt's production directory, and of its
# staging directory.
data "pbs_acme_tos" "letsencrypt" {}

data "pbs_acme_tos" "letsencrypt_staging" {
  directory = "https://acme-staging-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory"
}

output "letsencrypt_tos" {
  value = data.pbs_acme_tos.letsencrypt.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `directory` (String) URL of the ACME directory. Defaults to Let's Encrypt's production directory, `https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory`.

### Read-Only

- `url` (String) URL of the terms of service; null when the directory advertises none.
